ns2:section.sectionText: Creative Improvisation. For Unit One students only. 1 hour S/U credit. Practical application of melodic, harmonic, and rhythmic principles used in blues, jazz, and rock improvisation. Presentation of basic improvisational sequences, modal improvising, scale and chord usage, and approach-note techniques. Emphasis will be placed on creative approaches to creating melodies from the materials of class discussions. Working knowledge of fundamentals of an instrument required.
